No. 2063/32– THURSDAY MARCH 22, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No. NE/3/1/8/Acquisition/143.

I, hereby give Notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired:

Allotments of land in total extent about 0.4947 Hectare described as Lot 01 in preliminary Plan No. Nu 3151 of 03.10.2017 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in Dayagama West (Division No. 1) Village in Sandiriham 476 R Grama Niladhari Division in Oya Palatha Korale Minor Division in Nuwara Eliya Divisional Secretary’s Division, in Nuwara Eliya District and bounded as follows :
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Dayagama West (Division No. 1); Details: Tea Cultivation; Claimant: Agarapatana Plantations Ltd, Voxhalla Street, Colombo 02; Extent about: 0.4947 Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands are to be acquired hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat on the 25th day of April 2018 at 10.30 a.m. and

are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of April 2018. The nature of their interests in the land. The particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
S. P. K. BODHIMANNA, Divisional Secretary, Nuwara Eliya.
Divisional Secretariat, Nuwara Eliya, 19th March, 2018.
